metaTitle: Custom 3 oz Coffee Mugs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 3 oz coffee mugs in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for espresso, tasting, or sample servings. Get your quote today.
introHtml: Custom 3 oz coffee mugs are the perfect size for espresso shots, tasting flights, or sample servings at trade shows and coffee shops. Their compact footprint makes them easy to pack and distribute in bulk, while still offering ample space for your logo or message. Whether you choose ceramic or glass, these tiny mugs create a memorable impression that stands out from standard 12 or 16 oz options.
heroAltText: Custom 3 oz coffee mugs with logo imprint, ideal for espresso or tasting servings
